setting-enable_vibrant_shaders-tooltip: Master toggle for every VibrantShaders effect. Disable for quick side-by-side comparison with neutral shader values.
setting-vibrance_strength-tooltip: KWin-style vibrance in linear RGB. 0 = disabled, 0.5 = KWin 150%, 0.911 = default, 1.0 = maximum.
setting-warm_shadows-tooltip: Adds warm (orange/yellow) tint to dark areas. Creates a cozy atmosphere.
setting-cool_highlights-tooltip: Adds cool (blue) tint to bright areas. Enhances sky and snow reflections.
setting-vignette_strength-tooltip: Darkens screen edges for a cinematic look. 0 = disabled.
setting-vignette_softness-tooltip: How gradually the vignette fades. Lower = harder edge, higher = softer blend.
setting-film_grain-tooltip: Adds subtle animated noise for a cinematic film look. 0 = disabled.
setting-moonlight_strength-tooltip: How much moonlight illuminates dark areas at night. Brightness varies with moon phase. 0 = disabled.
setting-moonlight_blue_tint-tooltip: How blue the moonlight appears. 0 = white light, 1.0 = full blue tint.
setting-blue_boost-tooltip: Enhances blues and cyans. Makes snow, sky, and water more vibrant.
setting-green_boost-tooltip: Enhances greens. Makes foliage and grass more lush.
setting-warm_boost-tooltip: Enhances oranges, yellows, and reds. Makes autumn colors and warm light pop.
setting-shadow_blueness-tooltip: Adds blue tint to shadows for outdoor realism. Simulates sky ambient light in shadows.
setting-tonemap_strength-tooltip: ACES-style highlight rolloff. Higher values make bright areas softer and more cinematic.
setting-bloom_strength-tooltip: Controls soft bloom intensity from bright and glowing parts of the scene.
setting-bloom_soft_knee-tooltip: How gently bloom enters highlights. Higher values make bloom broader and smoother.
setting-depth_haze_strength-tooltip: Adds subtle distance haze using the scene depth buffer. 0 = disabled.
setting-depth_haze_distance-tooltip: Controls where distance haze starts. Lower = closer haze, higher = farther haze.
setting-godray_strength-tooltip: Balances vanilla godrays before VibrantShaders grading. Lower values reduce sunrise glare.
setting-scene_lift_strength-tooltip: Raises dull shadows and midtones so outdoor scenes feel less flat.
setting-local_contrast_strength-tooltip: Adds screen-space midtone detail contrast to keep terrain and objects from looking smeared.
setting-color_richness-tooltip: Adds filmic midtone color density without pushing already saturated pixels as hard.
setting-earth_tone_separation-tooltip: Separates flat yellow and brown terrain into slightly warmer and greener tones.
setting-season_grass_correction-tooltip: Deprecated broad final-color correction. Keep disabled unless testing.
setting-seasonal_grass_influence-tooltip: Controls how strongly vanilla seasonal grass colormaps affect topsoil and grass. 1 = vanilla, 0 = climate tint only.
setting-climate_plant_influence-tooltip: Controls how strongly vanilla climatePlantTint affects grass, leaves, and plant-tinted terrain. 1 = vanilla, 0 = base texture only.
setting-frost_tint_influence-tooltip: Controls the white shader frost overlay applied to frostable terrain in freezing temperatures. 0 keeps winter color changes to actual snow blocks and snow-covered variants.
setting-colormap_naturalize_strength-too: Tames extreme vanilla climate and season tint colors before they multiply terrain and foliage. 0 = vanilla tint hue, 1 = strongest correction.
setting-colormap_chroma_strength-tooltip: Controls saturation of sampled climate and season colormap tints. 1 = vanilla saturation, lower = flatter tint, higher = stronger tint color.
setting-colormap_yellow_green_guard-tool: Reduces acidic yellow-green bias in vanilla terrain and foliage colormap tints without changing unrelated screen colors.
setting-colormap_brightness-tooltip: Brightens or darkens sampled climate and season colormap tints before they multiply base textures. 1 = unchanged.
setting-warm_light_stability-tooltip: Protects torch, lava, and lamp-lit highlights from extra final-pass color shifts. Higher values keep warm lights closer to vanilla while leaving other colors vibrant.
setting-golden_hour_strength-tooltip: Adds warm highlight and cool shadow separation around sunrise and sunset.
